title: CogArena：大语言模型认知能力结构的多方法评估
summary: CogArena是一个程序化生成的13范式基准测试，采用多方法框架评估LLM认知分数何时能赋予维度标签。对55个开放权重模型的研究发现，几乎所有范式间相关性为正，共同轴解释约一半方差。分组内优势较小且不确定，针对性提示仅产生微小优势，未能通过多重比较校正和跨族外推验证。结论是当前证据不足以建立稳定的五维认知轮廓。
summary_en: CogArena is a procedurally generated 13-paradigm benchmark using a multimethod framework to determine when LLM cognitive scores warrant dimensional labels. Across 55 open-weight models, nearly all paradigm correlations are positive, with a common axis explaining about half the variance. Within-grouping advantage is small and uncertain; targeted scaffolds show minimal advantage, failing multiplicity correction and cross-family prediction. The evidence does not support stable five-dimensional profiles.
